snippet.title: Dino Rush Race trailer - multiplayer 2D runner game with level editor
snippet.description:
Get Dino Rush Race  now for free ! 
On iOS : https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/dino-rush-race/id1308363336?mt=8

On Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=net.ponytech.dinorushrace

Go faster than your opponents in this new 2D racing game! 
This is the sequel of 2010 critically acclaimed Dino Rush game

Soundtrack by: Rupert Cole
